image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vertical traffic light suspended from overhead wires against a clear blue sky. The traffic light housing is dark gray/black with three circular lenses stacked vertically: red (top, illuminated), amber (middle, unlit but visible), and green (bottom, illuminated). Each lens has a textured, faceted surface typical of LED or prismatic lenses. Visors extend over each lens. To the left of the main signal head is a cylindrical backplate or mounting component. Wires and a metal support structure are visible at the top.
